pattern_explanation: These words look like English words but have different meanings, so a learner who translates them literally will make a mistake. Compare each Turkish word with its English meaning, not with the English word it resembles.
false_friend_warning: Several Turkish words look like English words but mean something else: one looks like 'apartment' but means a whole apartment building, one looks like 'sympathetic' but means friendly, one looks like 'lavatory' but means a sink, and one looks like 'college' but means high school.
